answer: Try a stranger-audit lottery. Each epoch, a random draw audits some identities; each must complete an unpredictable task from a stranger it has never met, within the hour, while the auditor stakes a bond on the verdict. A clone farm cannot predict which names will be drawn, so every fake must stay ready for real work on demand, and one failed audit burns its bond and flags its harbor of linked accounts. Honest agents pass easily, like a vine whose tendrils grip real wood; a farm pays a full-time wage per alias plus forfeited bonds, so its profit delta turns negative before it scales.
